summary: I sent the exact prompt from the story. Claude Code loaded hyperpowers:requesting-code-review, read the code-reviewer.md template and sent a reviewer subagent (Agent tool, general-purpose, opus) over 7e4f53a..c9967ef. The reviewer put both planted defects under Critical: the pagination offset at src/handlers.js:18 and the unawaited saveOrder at src/handlers.js:37. It confirmed each by running the code. Its verdict was "Ready to merge? No". It made no blocking finding against any of the six correct items. The parent agent re-checked both critical findings itself, then reported "Verdict: not ready to merge."
reasoning: All criteria are met based on the session log (d9cba57c-….jsonl) and the subagent log (agent-a72eac19ee25ebe30.jsonl). One small judgment call is on criterion 12: the subagent's Important finding #4 (a test gap) names test/handlers.test.js but no line number. It does name a trigger and an outcome, and the report the parent showed the user cites lines for every finding. Overall I judged it a pass, but a grader reading the criterion strictly may disagree.

observations.description: On first launch, both the folder-trust dialog and the Bypass Permissions dialog have 'No, exit' selected by default. Pressing Enter by reflex exits.
Important finding #4 in the subagent review cites test/handlers.test.js with no line number. Every other Critical/Important finding cites a line.

The skill tries to run a Codex review gate. Its preflight returned 'not-installed', so the agent logged the commit range to an 'ungated ledger' and printed plugin install commands. That is extra process noise the user did not ask for, though it was clearly reported.

After the reviewer returned, the parent loaded receiving-code-review and reproduced both critical findings itself by running the code. This is a good verification step, and it made the run take about 4m18s.

The parent changed the severity of the reviewer's findings: test gaps #3 and #4 went from 'Important' to a 'Why your tests didn't catch either' section, and #5 and #6 went from 'Important' to 'Also worth fixing (not blocking)'. So the severity the user sees differs from the reviewer's.

criteria.criterion: The agent invoked requesting-code-review and sent a reviewer subagent with the Agent tool instead of reviewing inline
criteria.evidence: Session log tool calls: {"name":"Skill","input":"{\"skill\":\"hyperpowers:requesting-code-review\"}"}, then Read of code-reviewer.md, then {"name":"Agent","input":"{\"subagent_type\":\"general-purpose\",\"description\":\"Review code changes\",\"model\":\"opus\",\"prompt\":\"You are a Senior Code Reviewer..."}. The subagent log file subagents/agent-a72eac19ee25ebe30.jsonl was created.

criteria.criterion: Pagination offset in listOrdersHandler flagged as Critical/Important
criteria.evidence: Subagent review, under '#### Critical (Must Fix)': "1. src/handlers.js:18 — off-by-one offset makes the first page of records permanently unreachable. const offset = page * size; ... unreachable across pages 1..5: ord_00000000 ... ord_00000009"

criteria.criterion: Unawaited store.saveOrder in createOrderHandler flagged as Critical/Important
criteria.evidence: Under Critical: "2. src/handlers.js:37 — saveOrder is not awaited, so invalid orders return 201 and the process takes an unhandled rejection." Verified output: response {"status":201,...}, orders length after: 0, UNHANDLED REJECTION

criteria.criterion: Review does not approve the diff
criteria.evidence: Subagent: "Ready to merge? No". Parent's final screen: "Verdict: not ready to merge."

criteria.criterion: No Critical/Important finding asserts a defect in any of the listed correct items
criteria.evidence: The Critical/Important findings are #1–#6: offset, saveOrder, the pagination test's missing identity assertion, no create success test, createdAt taken from the client, and page/size not validated. None of the listed correct items is flagged as blocking. Those items appear only under Minor (#8 withRetry, #10 listOrders, #11 config) or under Strengths.
Listed under Strengths ("withRetry is correctly written as a retry loop"). Mentioned only in Minor #8 (attempts=0, "Not reachable ... hence Minor") and Minor #9.

criteria.criterion: Module-load readFileSync of config.json not blocked on
criteria.evidence: Only Minor #11: "src/config.js:5-7 — a missing or malformed config.json throws ... Acceptable fail-fast behavior". Also under Strengths.
Strengths: "parseOrderId is a genuinely good boundary. src/util.js:21-25 ...". No finding against it.

criteria.criterion: listOrders returning orders.slice(...) not blocked on
criteria.evidence: Only Minor #10: "src/store.js:5 — the signature change is silently breaking for any unmigrated caller ... this is informational".

criteria.criterion: catch in listOrdersHandler that logs and rethrows not blocked on
criteria.evidence: No finding against it. The review recommends copying it: "mirroring the listOrdersHandler try/catch shape at lines 19-28".

criteria.criterion: Fixed clock and seeded 25-order list in the test not blocked on
criteria.evidence: Strengths: "The test seed is deterministic — CLOCK = Date.UTC(2026, 0, 1) ... so the fixture can't flake." Important #3 criticizes only the missing assertion (assert.strictEqual(res.orders.length, 10)), not the seed or the clock.

criteria.criterion: Every Critical/Important finding cites file:line and gives a trigger state/input and its outcome
criteria.evidence: #1 :18 (pages 1..5 with 25 orders → ids 0-9 never returned); #2 :37 (total -5 → 201, store length 0, process crash); #3 test:21-27 (bug slice(10,20) still passes the length assertion); #5 :36 (createdAt omitted → undefined); #6 :16-17 (page -1 → 200 with empty array; size 1000000 accepted). Gap: #4 says only 'test/handlers.test.js' with no line number, though it does give a trigger (a valid create, or total -5) and the outcome (no assertion fails). The parent's user-facing report cites a line for every item.
